summary.fr: Tempo bleu : Delver of Secrets, Faerie Miscreant et Spellstutter Sprite, Spire Golem presque gratuit, Gush et Daze sans mana ; une version ajoutait Lightning Bolt et Ninja of the Deep Hours.
summary.en: Blue tempo: Delver of Secrets, Faerie Miscreant and Spellstutter Sprite, a nearly free Spire Golem, Gush and Daze for no mana; one version added Lightning Bolt and Ninja of the Deep Hours.

fr: Victoires en Pauper Challenge sur Magic Online, en bleu et en bleu-rouge
Vinicius Netto a gagné le premier Pauper Masters en version bleu-rouge
en: Won Magic Online Pauper Challenges, in mono blue and blue-red
Vinicius Netto won the first Pauper Masters with the blue-red version

summary.fr: Kor Skyfisher et Glint Hawk renvoyaient en main Alchemist's Vial et Prophetic Prism pour les rejouer, Palace Sentinels apportait le monarque, Lightning Bolt et Galvanic Blast dégageaient.
summary.en: Kor Skyfisher and Glint Hawk returned Alchemist's Vial and Prophetic Prism to hand to replay them, Palace Sentinels brought the monarch, and Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Blast cleared the way.

fr: Mario Brecciaroli a gagné l'Italian National Pauper Cup
Victoires aussi au Rags to Riches de Seattle et en Pauper Challenge
Palace Sentinels venait de Conspiracy: Take the Crown, sorti en août 2016
en: Mario Brecciaroli won the Italian National Pauper Cup
Also won the Rags to Riches in Seattle and Pauper Challenges
Palace Sentinels came from Conspiracy: Take the Crown, released in August 2016

summary.fr: Les terrains-artefacts rendaient Frogmite, Myr Enforcer et Thoughtcast presque gratuits ; Atog sacrifiait les artefacts et Temur Battle Rage doublait l'attaque.
summary.en: Artifact lands made Frogmite, Myr Enforcer and Thoughtcast nearly free; Atog sacrificed the artifacts and Temur Battle Rage doubled the attack.

fr: Alexandre Weber a gagné le championnat national du Brésil de Pauper 2017
Victoires aussi en Pauper Challenge sur Magic Online et à la Liga Madrileña
en: Alexandre Weber won the 2017 Brazilian National Pauper Championship
Also won Magic Online Pauper Challenges and a Liga Madrileña event

summary.fr: Vert agressif : Nettle Sentinel, Burning-Tree Emissary et Skarrgan Pit-Skulk dès les premiers tours, Rancor et Hunger of the Howlpack pour frapper fort, Vines of Vastwood protégeait.
summary.en: Green aggro: Nettle Sentinel, Burning-Tree Emissary and Skarrgan Pit-Skulk in the first turns, Rancor and Hunger of the Howlpack to hit hard, and Vines of Vastwood as protection.

fr: Gregory Grundy a gagné le Rags to Riches 13
Victoires aussi en Pauper Challenge sur Magic Online
en: Gregory Grundy won Rags to Riches 13
Also won Magic Online Pauper Challenges

summary.fr: Les trois terrains Urza donnaient sept manas : Mulldrifter et Mnemonic Wall avec Ghostly Flicker pour l'avantage, Flame Slash et Pulse of Murasa contre les decks agressifs.
summary.en: The three Urza lands made seven mana: Mulldrifter and Mnemonic Wall with Ghostly Flicker for card advantage, Flame Slash and Pulse of Murasa against aggro decks.

fr: Jace Mickelson a gagné le Rags to Riches 16 à Seattle
Victoires aussi en Pauper Challenge sur Magic Online
en: Jace Mickelson won Rags to Riches 16 in Seattle
Also won Magic Online Pauper Challenges

summary.fr: Contrôle bleu-noir : Counterspell, Chainer's Edict et Doom Blade, Chittering Rats et Mulldrifter pour l'avantage, Ghostly Flicker pour les rejouer.
summary.en: Blue-black control: Counterspell, Chainer's Edict and Doom Blade, Chittering Rats and Mulldrifter for card advantage, and Ghostly Flicker to replay them.

fr: Victoires au Rags to Riches 7 et 8, en version à Mystical Teachings ou Accumulated Knowledge
Deuxième plusieurs fois en Pauper Challenge sur Magic Online
en: Won Rags to Riches 7 and 8, with Mystical Teachings or Accumulated Knowledge
Second several times in Magic Online Pauper Challenges

summary.fr: Elfes producteurs de mana, Birchlore Rangers et Priest of Titania ; Distant Melody rechargeait la main, Timberwatch Elf ou Lys Alana Huntmaster finissaient.
summary.en: Mana-producing elves, Birchlore Rangers and Priest of Titania; Distant Melody refilled the hand, and Timberwatch Elf or Lys Alana Huntmaster finished.

fr: Steven Robbins a gagné le Rags to Riches 14
Victoires aussi en Pauper Challenge et au 20e anniversaire de Magic Corner
en: Steven Robbins won Rags to Riches 14
Also won a Pauper Challenge and the Magic Corner 20th anniversary event

summary.fr: Slippery Bogle et Gladecover Scout, qu'on ne peut pas cibler, recevaient Ethereal Armor, Ancestral Mask, Rancor et Armadillo Cloak.
summary.en: Slippery Bogle and Gladecover Scout, which cannot be targeted, received Ethereal Armor, Ancestral Mask, Rancor and Armadillo Cloak.

fr: A gagné un Pauper Challenge sur Magic Online en octobre
Top 8 au championnat national du Brésil
en: Won a Magic Online Pauper Challenge in October
Top eight at the Brazilian National Championship

summary.fr: Rouge à brûlures : Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Rift Bolt et Lava Spike, Thermo-Alchemist et Curse of the Pierced Heart infligeaient des dégâts chaque tour, Fireblast finissait.
summary.en: Red burn: Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Rift Bolt and Lava Spike, Thermo-Alchemist and Curse of the Pierced Heart dealing damage every turn, and Fireblast to finish.

fr: Michael Wallio a gagné le Rags to Riches 9
Top 4 aussi au Rags to Riches 16 à Seattle
en: Michael Wallio won Rags to Riches 9
Also top four at Rags to Riches 16 in Seattle

summary.fr: Tireless Tribe défaussait des cartes pour gagner en endurance, Inside Out échangeait force et endurance et Shadow Rift la rendait presque imblocable.
summary.en: Tireless Tribe discarded cards to gain toughness, Inside Out switched its power and toughness, and Shadow Rift made it nearly unblockable.

fr: A gagné un Pauper Challenge sur Magic Online en septembre
Deuxième en Pauper Challenge en novembre et en décembre
en: Won a Magic Online Pauper Challenge in September
Second in Pauper Challenges in November and December

summary.en: Kiln Fiend and Nivix Cyclops grew with each spell, Gitaxian Probe and Mutagenic Growth were cast for free, and Temur Battle Rage doubled the damage.

fr: A gagné un Pauper Challenge sur Magic Online en novembre
Apostle's Blessing protégeait la créature des réponses
en: Won a Magic Online Pauper Challenge in November
Apostle's Blessing protected the creature from removal

summary.en: Delver of Secrets with Thought Scour and Mental Note filling the graveyard: Gurmag Angler cost one mana, and Exhume brought back a cycled Striped Riverwinder.

fr: A gagné un Pauper Challenge sur Magic Online en août
Victoire au MTGTA.COM Pauper Championship en Chine en 2016
en: Won a Magic Online Pauper Challenge in August
Won the MTGTA.COM Pauper Championship in China in 2016

summary.fr: Boros agressif : Kuldotha Rebirth sacrifiait Ichor Wellspring pour trois gobelins, Battle Screech donnait des oiseaux, Rally the Peasants finissait.
summary.en: Boros aggro: Kuldotha Rebirth sacrificed Ichor Wellspring for three goblins, Battle Screech made birds, and Rally the Peasants finished.

fr: Top 4 au Rags to Riches 10
Top 8 aussi au Rags to Riches 7
en: Top four at Rags to Riches 10
Also top eight at Rags to Riches 7

summary.en: Sunscape Familiar reduced the cost of blue spells, Snap bounced a creature while untapping lands, and Ghostly Flicker and Mnemonic Wall replayed spells in a loop.

fr: Troisième en Pauper Challenge sur Magic Online en juillet et en décembre
Dinrova Horror renvoyait une carte adverse
en: Third in Magic Online Pauper Challenges in July and December
Dinrova Horror bounced an opposing card

summary.fr: Contrôle blanc-noir : Pestilence balayait les petites créatures, Guardian of the Guildpact, protégé des sorts monocolores, survivait ; Lone Missionary et Aven Riftwatcher rendaient des points de vie.
summary.en: White-black control: Pestilence swept small creatures, Guardian of the Guildpact, with protection from monocolored, survived, and Lone Missionary and Aven Riftwatcher gained life.

fr: Troisième en Pauper Challenge sur Magic Online en octobre
Top 8 au Goldmine Pauper Tournament
en: Third in a Magic Online Pauper Challenge in October
Top eight at the Goldmine Pauper Tournament
